newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 6-mth T-bill yield falls to 67.97 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 6-mth T-bill yield falls to 67.97 pct.

text.p: The average yield on an issue of six-month GKO discount Treasury bills fell to 67.97 percent at an auction on Wednesday from 78.18 percent at the last auction of six-month paper a week ago, the central bank said.
The yield was just below dealers' forecasts of an average yield in the 68-80 percent range.
Issue volume 7.50 trln rbls 7.00 trln rbls

Earlier the ministry sold 2.27 trillion roubles in a new tranche of the 18-month OFZ interest-bearing bond maturing in February 1997 (series 24003), at an average price of 95.25 percent, to raise 2.22 trillion roubles, taking total proceeds from today's auctions to about 7.50 trillion roubles.
It is also offering one trillion roubles in one-year OGSZ savings bonds.
It is also repaying about 6.50 trillion roubles in maturing six-month bills (series 22024) and paying about 820 billion roubles in interest on two-year OFZ bond maturing March 1998 (series 24007).
